admission.justification: test_dashboard_host shows the dashboard adapter's stop leaves ensure_host uncalled and covers adoption/autoStart; process-KILL and dashboard-death preservation is established by the separately dated real witness, whose limit is recorded in L96-witness-on-earlier-source, not by a unit case.

applicability: Dashboard supervision commands: --daemon, --status, --stop, TERM/KILL of a dashboard, Ctrl-C on a foreground dashboard and dashboard ensure on a mismatch.
conditions: The dashboard's stop signals only the one recorded dashboard process; the host is started detached and is never the dashboard's child or process-group member.
exclusions: `agents-remember paseo stop --config <file>` stays the one host-stop command.
A settings file without the block keeps today's statuses.
The help texts of paseo provision/stop are documentation, not a new command.
